items.instrument: D8 advanced, Bruker, Germany powder diffractometer equipped with a dynamic scintillation detector and ceramic X-ray Cu tube (KFL-Cu-2 K)
items.quote: for phase identification of samples were recorded on a D8 advanced, Bruker, Germany powder diffractometer equipped with a dynamic scintillation detector and ceramic X-ray Cu tube (KFL-Cu-2 K) in a 2θ range from 10° to 75° with a step size of 0.02°.
The third part of samples were investigated by differential thermal analysis (DTA). The DTA measurements were performed on a DTG-60H (Shimadzu, China).
